description: This file defines an interface for listening to configuration reload events related to the service engine in the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ServiceConfigListener
classes.description: An interface that receives notifications when the 'serviceengine.xml' configuration file is reloaded, allowing implementing classes to handle configuration changes.

methods.name: onServiceConfigChange
methods.description: Method to process updates when the ServiceConfig changes, taking a ServiceConfig instance as a parameter.
